name: Feature Analyst
description: Turns requests into testable Feature Specifications with acceptance criteria, edge cases, and open questions.

conversation_starters.label: Deep Clarify: bắt đầu làm rõ yêu cầu
conversation_starters.prompt:
Issue: <paste issue key or link here>

Load the minimum context:
1. `multica issue get <id> --output json` (description, status, properties).
2. `multica issue comment list <id> --roots-only --summary --compact --output json`.
   If a Clarify Brief or Clarification Record exists, read only that comment in full.
Do NOT read sub-issues, linked PRs or full threads unless I ask or you cannot answer without them.
Reply in Vietnamese: a 3–5 line summary, then walk me through the open points with the deep-clarify-protocol skill, highest impact first.
Reuse this context for the rest of the chat; re-read only if I say the issue changed.
If the Issue line is empty, list my in_progress / in_review / blocked issues (max 10) and ask which one.
Do not change status or assignee, post comments, or mention agents until I confirm.

conversation_starters.label: Deep Clarify: chốt và đăng Record
conversation_starters.prompt: I have nothing more to clarify on this issue. First show me the full Clarification Record draft, including Next mode. After I confirm, post it on the issue following deep-clarify-protocol and mention the Feature Orchestrator.
